scripts.dev:up: ENV_FILE=.env.local docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.override.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml --env-file .env.local up -d
scripts.dev:down: ENV_FILE=.env.local docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.override.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml --env-file .env.local down
scripts.dev:worker:up: ENV_FILE=.env.local docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml --env-file .env.local up -d postgres redis && pnpm --filter @tower-of-habit/worker dev
scripts.dev:api:up: ENV_FILE=.env.local docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml --env-file .env.local up -d postgres redis && pnpm --filter @tower-of-habit/api dev
